def transform(grid):
    """Overlay the two non-background patterns across the solid divider."""
    divider = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                    if row and all(v == row[0] for v in row)), None)
    if divider is None:
        raise ValueError("no solid divider row")
    upper, lower = grid[:divider], grid[divider + 1:]
    if len(upper) != len(lower):
        raise ValueError("pattern halves must have equal height")
    width = len(grid[0])
    return [[2 if upper[r][c] != 0 and lower[r][c] != 0 else 0
             for c in range(width)] for r in range(len(upper))]
PY
